source.author: verg
source.text: Talia voce refert, curisque ingentibus aeger spem voltu simulat, premit altum corde dolorem.
source.text_original: Talia voce refert, curisque ingentibus aeger / spem voltu simulat, premit altum corde dolorem.
source.text_english: He speaks thus with his voice, sick with great anxieties, he simulates hope in his face, and represses deep grief in his heart.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ipsum etiam curisque parem talesque prementem corde metus ducit, facilem tamen, Aesona coniunx.
reuse.text_original: ipsum etiam curisque parem talesque prementem / corde metus ducit, facilem tamen, Aesona coniunx.
reuse.text_english: It also leads him to fear himself, equal to his cares and weighing down such fears in his heart, yet tractable, wife of Aeson.
